vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba contract has a pause() function that can only be called by the owner. When paused, regular users cannot transfer tokens, but the owner can still transfer (due to 'sender == owner() || recipient == owner()' exception in _transfer). This allows the owner to pause the contract, preventing others from selling while the owner can still dump tokens, manipulating the market.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the current owner of the contract. 2. Call pause() function to pause the contract. 3. Verify that paused == true.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 2. Call the pause() function on the DoctorShiba contract. 3. Check that the paused state variable is now true.
